limitations: Standalone anchor specimens do not reproduce full Body/Lid constraints; no mating counterpart, datum or clamp has been planned.
B/C move the bearing plane to source-frame Z9/Z13 without redesigning the original Lid. The old Lid/STLs are not assigned trial counterparts.
Only the anchor +X side contacts numeric Z0, about13.8 mm2; beam samples are about1.5 mm above and native root/miter samples about0.9 mm above. No base was added.
The general geometric checker accepts valid subdivision; this run separately proves the actual native42-point UI selection and 14/28 motion partition.
No material/strain/Q/deflection/force, support, printed result, strength, fit or improvement has been qualified.
